title: Shimano Breaks Pedal Compatibility, Canyon’s Handlebar Surprise, and Finding Ride Motivation | Velo Podcast
content:
The Velo crew unpacks the controversy around Shimano's new pedals and sharp critiques of the latest Canyon Grail. Plus, MVDP's latest achievement and how to find the motivation to get out the door when you just don't feel like it.

Read the full article at Shimano Breaks Pedal Compatibility, Canyon’s Handlebar Surprise, and Finding Ride Motivation | Velo Podcast on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
